1154. Integer Frequency Counter

50

Medium

Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to determine the frequency of each integer in a list. Use the Integer wrapper class and appropriate collection classes to achieve this. The program should use a Map<Integer, Integer> to count the occurrences of each integer and output the frequency of each integer in ascending order.
input_spec: The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the list. The second line contains N space-separated integers.
output_spec:
the frequency of each integer in ascending order.

Input Description:
The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the list. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output Description:
Print each integer and its frequency, sorted by the integer values.
